title: Box3D Playground
author: Seth Morrow
description: A tour of 3D physics with the box3dxt extension: every kind of shape, joints (a rope, a windmill, a sprung platform, a cart on wheels), a sensor gate with hit events, and a hilly terrain. Where the player has render3dxt, the Textured look draws it all with textures, smooth shading and fog; elsewhere box3dxt's own renderer draws it. Click a thing to kick it and drag to look around.
